## Safety

- [ ] The playbook is generic: `example.com`, no real domains, emails, customer data or credentials.
- [ ] Every command was run on a test install, or the playbook says it is untested.
- [ ] Destructive steps explain the backup first and the verification after.
- [ ] It does not ask an agent to disable a safety control, skip a confirmation or pipe a download into a shell.
- [ ] It does not override a bundled slug (or this PR explains why `override: true` is needed).
